source_paper.title: Food intake enhances hippocampal sharp wave-ripples

evidence.locator: Results; Figures 1–3; Methods: Data processing, analyses, and sleep scoring; Animals; Food restriction and experimental procedures
evidence.supports: The source studies pre/post-meal physiological changes, defines detection and session-level ratios, and identifies different experimental cohorts. It supplies no prediction or reconstruction accuracy benchmark.

Author deposit lists all-done.mat, 2022food_safe.xlsx, MainAnalysisScript.m, extractRippleAndFPStructs4.m, detectRipples.m and SleepQuantificationFeb2025.m. Inventory inspection does not establish raw-input completeness or archive-to-figure mapping.
Chow/no-food paired-session power, NREM rate and duration, dose associations, delta-power mediation and NREM-duration companion.
Ad-libitum chocolate control: nine animals, 39 sessions, four correlations and sleep-depth mediation.
Caloric Jello, sugar-free Jello and no-food controls; animal-level SWR/delta ratios, displayed means and standard errors, and pairwise contrasts.

evidence.locator: Materials and methods: Data processing, analyses, and sleep scoring; Food restriction and experimental procedures
evidence.supports: NREM-only analysis, sleep exclusion, shared pre/post thresholds, per-session POST/PRE ratios and events per NREM second; no independent-replication tolerance is prescribed.

Public source initializes POST from PRE, exports separately thresholded detector-2 power vectors, and divides rates by final selected NREM timestamps. These observations do not establish the generating revision of the release.

evidence.locator: detectRipples.m, Figshare version 1: threshold crossing and event windows; lines 4–32
evidence.supports: Source event power sums shifted RMS-envelope samples over an inclusive approximately 50 ms window; duration and power are distinct quantities, and events are not independent animals.

evidence.locator: MainAnalysisScript.m, Figshare version 1: constructor lines 78–104 and later food/chocolate analyses
evidence.supports: Constructor stores detector-specific ratios, rates, durations, delta measures and animal/day/condition identities; later legacy field names do not authenticate archive-to-figure membership.

target.description: Estimate pre/post-feeding changes in hippocampal SWR power, duration and rate, and their association with meal amount and sleep depth. This is an observational/experimental biological effect-estimation task.

dataset.description: Author release Data and code for Kaya et al. (2025), Figshare article 28691093 version 1. The historical task uses processed event/session structs in all-done.mat; raw-to-event inference is outside that preserved scope.

cohort.description: The paper distinguishes food-restricted chow, ad-libitum chocolate and Jello cohorts; Figure 2 reports nine animals/39 sessions and Figure 3 reports 7/9/10 animals across its conditions. The registration records 95 released sessions/10 animals, but their exact mapping to each paper figure and condition code was not verified from primary metadata.

split.description: The source compares paired pre/post sleep sessions and experimental food conditions; it defines no train/validation/test split or held-out prediction contest. A new animal split would introduce a new evaluation task.

inputs.description: For the preserved processed-event scope: author event/session ripple measurements, food conditions, NREM durations and animal/session identifiers. The deposit also lists analysis helpers; it does not by itself establish access to complete raw LFP and sleep-scoring inputs.

preprocessing.description: Source detection uses NREM only, excludes sessions with under 30 minutes sleep, filters LFP at 150–250 Hz, and requires peaks at least 5 SD with at least 40 ms above 1 SD. Pre/post comparisons use session means and postsleep/presleep ratios. Processed archive reproduction must preserve the originating detector and condition dictionary.

metric.description: Ripple fold changes, meal correlations and mediation coefficients describe physiology. None is an ordered method-performance loss whose improvement establishes a paper win.

aggregation.description: Paper analyses form session-level pre/post ratios; condition comparisons and captions distinguish animal and session counts. Repeated events and sessions cannot be silently promoted to independent animals.

full_panel.description: The registered central feeding-effect target comprises Figure 1C–K and its NREM-duration supplement, ad-libitum chocolate Figure 2B–F, and caloric/sugar-free/no-food Figure 3B–E. Preserve every original session/animal, all power/rate/duration and delta-power quantities, all food and sleep-depth associations, mediation paths and companion controls. Figure 1 requires complete quantitative session-wise ratio vectors with exact original identities in the granular computation outputs; no pooled scalar or categorical direction replaces them. The 95-session/10-animal processed archive is not an authenticated union of those figure panels. Hormone-administration Figure 4 and SWR-triggered LH photometry Figure 5 are outside this preserved registered target, not silently counted as reproduced.

permitted_observations.description: Both conditions require the same original, provenance-bound processed observations and identities: source detector-specific PRE/POST event measurements, meal amount and condition, animal/day/session membership, NREM exposure and delta-power observations sufficient to derive the registered original findings. Paper+data+author-code adds only the unchanged four public author MATLAB sources. Stored benchmark answers, source aggregate copying, repaired POST prefixes, reinterpreted numeric condition codes, missing raw LFP/sleep data and newly inferred detector identities are not substitutes for authenticated observation support. The existing detector-2-only packet does not supply the original full panel, rates or mediation inputs.

blocking_issues: Exact mapping of the 95-session/10-animal archive to original chow, chocolate and Jello figure panels and condition codes is unresolved; archive coverage is not paper-panel coverage.

Figure 1 per-session magnitude vectors require exact source identities, values and granular verification. Categorical patterns and the 38/31 counts cannot replace them; no scalar family or invented pooled summary is used. Missing archive-to-panel lineage is a genuine source gap, independently of the scalar/categorical findings schema.
Paper joint PRE/POST detector thresholds are not reconciled with the exported separate-threshold detector-2 event powers; detector-1 summary fields do not establish original observation lineage.

The public extractor initializes POST arrays with PRE data before appending later recordings; the archive generating revision and POST-only temporal identity remain unresolved. Neither matching nor nonmatching processed prefixes settles this.

The paper defines SWR rate per NREM second, while public source divides event counts by final selected NREM timestamps. Original NREM occupancy, event membership and rate definitions require reconciliation.

Complete delta-power, NREM-duration and mediation design/normalization support is not delivered by the existing power2/duration2 packet; source coefficients and p-values cannot be computationally reproduced by printing their published values.

Exact displayed Figure 3 group means/standard errors, full animal-level magnitudes, unrecovered Figure 1 duration association and NREM test statistic, and any additional figure mediation path outputs remain unresolved; no figure digitization or surrogate scalar has been introduced.
No source-justified numerical tolerance, equivalence decision, independent-unit minimum or confidence level has been frozen. Reported nonsignificance is not evidence of equivalence or reproduction.

Existing prepare.py, core.reference, score.py, stage_view.py and run_program.py implement the archived detector-2 reconstruction interface only. No authenticated full original-panel analysis interface, independent granular verifier or full-panel data manifest exists for an admission policy.

Matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code original-panel delivery, exposure policy, independent executions, verification identities and cumulative resource/access budgets remain unresolved. Existing historical controls do not fill the four new outcome cells.
